meta.name: frame-light-leak-cinema
meta.description: 胶片漏光 + 颗粒噪点 + 16:9 letterbox + 衬线大字, 电影感开场 / 章节卡

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给视频添加胶片漏光与电影感字幕
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想让视频片段拥有复古胶片电影的开场效果。
copy.tagline_en: Add film light leaks and cinematic subtitles to videos
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to give your video clips a retro film look with light leaks and letterbox.

howto.what: 装好后，Claude 能生成带有胶片漏光、颗粒噪点和衬线大字的电影感单帧画面（开场或章节卡），格式为 16:9 或 2.39:1 letterbox，并自动添加时间码等电影元素。
howto.when: 当你要求制作电影感开场画面、章节卡，或提供标题、场景等具体信息时触发。

say.text: 帮我做一个暖橙漏光的电影开场帧，标题是“REEL 01”。
say.note: 生成一帧带漏光和颗粒的电影感画面。

say.text: 设计一个胶片划痕和齿孔效果的帧，标题自拟，以1985年为场景。
say.note: 添加额外胶片纹理细节。

howto.what_en: Claude can generate a cinematic single frame with film light leaks, grain, and serif text, formatted as 16:9 or 2.39:1 letterbox, including timecode and other film elements.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for a cinematic opening frame, chapter card, or provide a title, scene, or other specific details.

say_en.text: Create a warm orange light leak cinematic frame with the title 'REEL 01'.
say_en.note: Generates a frame with light leak and grain.

say_en.text: Generate a 16:9 chapter card with dark green background, 35mm grain, and subtitle 'Chapter II'.
say_en.note: Outputs a chapter card matching specifications.

say_en.text: Design a frame with film scratches and sprocket holes, set in 1985, with a self-provided title.
